headline: Accepted $1,000 Cummings Foundation donation for Horace Mann Laboratory School; agreed to schedule a further discussion of the school bus camera system.
summary: Member Stott presented on automated school bus cameras, which recorded 3,371 suspected stop-arm violations in a late 2024 Salem pilot. Members raised concerns about data privacy, vendor selection, and police review workload. A public speaker also opposed a charter school's plan to add 366 seats.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the October 5, 2026 meeting minutes and warrants dated October 8 and October 15, 2026, unanimously.
Agreed to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting on the school bus camera system and RFP options.
Accepted a $1,000 unrestricted donation from the Cummings Foundation for Horace Mann Laboratory School, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: The consent agenda included the minutes of the October 5, 2026 School Committee meeting and warrants dated October 8 and October 15, 2026. Motion: Approve consent agenda items. Moved by: Member Hoffman | Seconded by: Member Cornell Vote: Motion passed unanimously.
The Committee agreed to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting inviting Police Chief Miller, legal counsel, and community stakeholders to further discuss the system and RFP options.

Motion: Accept a $1,000 unrestricted donation from the Cummings Foundation (Cummings Community Giving Program) for the Horace Mann Laboratory School. Moved by: Member Cornell | Seconded by: Member Hoffman Vote: Motion passed unanimously.
